title: A Study Investigating the Impact of IMT With CR On Exercise Responses In HF
official: Impact Of Adding Inspiratory Muscle Training To Cardiac Rehabilitation On Exercise Responses In Heart Failure
summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the impact of inspiratory muscle training (IMT) combined with cardiac rehabilitation (CR) on cardiovascular function in patients with heart failure.
conditions: Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction
